question: In a certain code language, ‘STAY’ is written as ‘65’ and ‘COME’ is written as ‘36’. How will ‘LIST’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

‘STAY’ is written as ‘65’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db8e53cf11abd8c4c9bca1424bdc6646e9e0595d45f746d057a410ef3dc56904.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b1051d09c550d6d739e561598292dd4bb811abea66fa8715141d9b41db4f61c6.png] 

And,

‘COME’ is written as ‘36’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cccbb3b857dcb04d16be368261e29b3479c7d699c215adcaffc60ad54cca501a.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/56946d8cfbb8d8b672f24fb0fd2b16b23c0cf03c5aa9df2032d36f3a18eee308.png] 

Similarly,

‘LIST’ is written as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7de5659d7f48117e2711e8cc9948d5294e3e6ded3b1d863e29a1c798d7aedcf7.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2ea4718a1dc1ec42d98794a99918935cb102ef7e4b2fcef7e583638312c10be5.png] 

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
